# cpanel_mysql_databases (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel MySQL or MariaDB database-name inventory through `Mysql::list_databases`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_databases" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `databases` (List of String) The complete database names in sorted order.
